jova.headline: Meet Jova.
jova.userQuery: What should I deal with first?

jovaResponse.what: Your employment contract template has not been updated to reflect recent legislative changes. Three active employee contracts reference the outdated version.
jovaResponse.why: Non-compliant employment documents create legal exposure and may invalidate key contractual terms. This is your highest-priority open item.
jovaResponse.action: Review and update the employment contract template using the Jojan One document generator, then re-issue to affected employees.
jovaResponse.source: People & HR · Employment Documents · Last reviewed 14 months ago
